#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Regenerate catalog_owners.py by running the fixed collect() logic."""
import re, sys
from pathlib import Path

SRC = Path("src/hackingtool")
OUT = SRC / "catalog_owners.py"
_URL = re.compile(r"(?<!api\.)github\.com/([A-Za-z0-9._-]+)/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+")
_NOT_OWNERS = {"search", "repos", "orgs", "org"}
HEADER = '''"""GitHub owners of tools we already ship — GENERATED, do not edit.

Regenerate with: uv run python scripts/gen_catalog_owners.py
"""

CATALOG_OWNERS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
'''

owners_set = set()
for p in sorted(SRC.rglob("*")):
    if p.suffix in (".yaml", ".py") and p.is_file() and p.name != OUT.name:
        text = p.read_text(errors="ignore")
        found = _URL.findall(text)
        for o in found:
            if o.lower() not in _NOT_OWNERS:
                owners_set.add(o)

owners_sorted = sorted(owners_set, key=[redacted:credential-assignment])
body = "".join(f'    "{o}",\n' for o in owners_sorted)
result = HEADER + body + "})\n"
OUT.write_text(result)
print(f"Regenerated {OUT.name} with {len(owners_sorted)} owners")
